game_title: Name Tag Match – Watchtower Ring Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring, towers along the town wall: the herald must handle bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing banners before they reach bandits.
theme: The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring: towers along the town wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Watchtower Ring, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing banners before they reach bandits. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the herald ahead. Then check the tag_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the town gate by solving code steps involving tag_matches that move the herald forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the town gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Name Tag Match' (Week 1 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Watchtower Ring'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tag_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bandits in Watchtower Ring.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
